Please don't open an issue as a first step.
Please post in the user support channels first. 
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5

 If there is a reason to open an issue, we will ask you to do that.
You could have mentioned all of this in the support channels.  None of what you have requested has anything to do with the xDrip code itself, which is what these issues are supposed to address, what needs to be fixed, or added, to the code.

@JasonJShuler Please communicate with me in any of the three channels I have proposed to you in the two threads you have been posting in today, and I will answer and explain and ask for your help and advice.
